words.example: It is hard for him to show his emotions.
She could not move because of fear.

example_translations.ru: От страха она не могла пошевелиться.

words.example: There was panic when the lights went out.
His decision to leave was a shock to everyone.

example_translations.ru: Его решение уйти стало шоком для всех.
example_translations.uz: Uning ketish haqidagi qarori hamma uchun shok bo'ldi.

words.example: Do you regret selling your old house?

example_translations.ru: Вы сожалеете, что продали свой старый дом?

words.example: Everyone showed sympathy when I lost my job.

example_translations.ru: Все проявили сочувствие, когда я потерял работу.
example_translations.uz: Men ishimdan ayrilganimda hamma hamdardlik bildirdi.

words.example: Lola suffered a lot when her best friend moved away.

example_translations.ru: Лола очень страдала, когда её лучшая подруга уехала.
example_translations.uz: Eng yaqin dugonasi ko'chib ketganida Lola juda qiynaldi.

words.example: His face turned red with anger.
How did your parents react to the news?

example_translations.ru: Как ваши родители отреагировали на эту новость?
example_translations.uz: Ota-onangiz bu xabarga qanday munosabat bildirdi?

words.example: Children often express their feelings through drawings.

example_translations.ru: Дети часто выражают свои чувства в рисунках.
example_translations.uz: Bolalar ko'pincha his-tuyg'ularini rasmlar orqali ifodalaydi.
